name: bananloop
description: Chat-first entry point for independent, reproducible autonomous improvement campaigns.

interface.longDescription: Use Codex for the conversational entry point while BananLoop owns evaluator freezing, staged evaluation, budgets, champion promotion and durable campaign state.
